reviews.reviewText:
Max paper from Lecture 30-45. T-test, Z-test most important.
Questions:
- F-test MCQs.
- Parameters related MCQs.
- Table given, write intervals.
Paper easy aya tha. Handouts ko acha sa read karain or final term ki video dakh lain YouTube sa.

📝 MCQs:  
✅ All MCQs were from files  
😌 Easy and less formula-based  

✍️ Subjective Questions:  
1️⃣ Define Null and Alternative Hypothesis  
2️⃣ Compute Sampling Distribution (Table with frequencies was given)  
3️⃣ Find the Confidence Interval  
4️⃣ Calculate Point Estimator  
5️⃣ Find relevant Hypothesis (Question was based on national cholesterol average e.g., 190 in America)  
6️⃣ E(X + 4) type question  
7️⃣ Properties of Density Function  

📚 Overall: Prepare theory well and revise file-based questions for better performance!
